input.quote: 20. INDEMNIFICATION 20.1 Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
input.rationale: Section 20 contains only a broad one-way Customer indemnity covering "every claim relating in any way" to our use of the Services; there is no Vendor indemnity anywhere in the Agreement for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach, or gross negligence/wilful misconduct. That is walk-away territory under the rule (no Vendor IP indemnity plus a one-way Customer indemnity for Vendor's services), and the fallback is also unmet. Section 9.3 already assumes infringement remedies "required by Section 20.5" that do not exist, confirming the gap. We therefore replaced 20.1 with the preferred Vendor indemnity, added usual exclusions, standard notice/control/cooperation procedure, and procure-modify-replace-refund remedies as new 20.5, and narrowed our indemnity to Customer-provided content and our breach of law. Note that the Section 21.1 cap is addressed separately under the liability rule; Section 21.3 already treats indemnification obligations as Excluded Claims.

proposal.summary: Add Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity, standard procedure and infringement remedies; narrow Customer's indemnity
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 20 currently runs one way only, so we have added Vendor's defence and indemnity for third-party IP claims, breaches of law, Vendor-caused data breaches and wilful misconduct, with the usual exclusions, notice/control procedure and procure-modify-replace-refund remedies (which Section 9.3 already cross-references as Section 20.5). We have narrowed our own indemnity to Customer-provided content and our breach of law, consistent with our playbook.

ops.oldText: Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
ops.newText: Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services, Deliverables, or Vendor Technology infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

ops.text: Vendor's indemnity in Section 20.1(a) does not apply to the extent a claim arises from Customer's modification of the Services or Deliverables contrary to Vendor's written instructions, combination of the Services or Deliverables with materials not supplied or recommended by Vendor where the claim would not have arisen absent the combination, or Vendor's compliance with Customer's written specifications.

Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from and against third-party claims to the extent arising out of Customer Data or other content Customer provides for use with the Services, or Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of the claim, and the indemnifying Party shall control the defence and settlement, provided that it shall not agree to any settlement imposing a non-monetary obligation or an admission of liability on the indemnified Party without that Party's prior written consent. The indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense and may participate with its own counsel at its own cost.

If the Services or Deliverables are alleged or found to infringe or misappropriate a third party's intellectual property right, Vendor shall, at its expense, procure for Customer the right to continue use, or modify or replace the affected item with a functionally equivalent non-infringing item. If neither remedy is reasonably available, Customer may terminate the affected item or Order Form and Vendor shall refund Fees paid for it, including prepaid Fees for the unused period.
